title: Allows newly added tracks to be selected
goal: Set a click monitor for the track list so that both the original button and the button added later can update the selection.
summary: button or its inner text is clicked, the click event will bubble up to the ancestor element. Lists can receive such events. closest() searches the button upwards starting from the click target, so clicking the span in the button can also find the track information.
tasks: listens for clicks on the parent container #song-list. Use event.target.closest() to find buttons with data-title.
When a button is found, its dataset.title is written to #selected-song. Keep the current track when clicking in an empty space in the list.
Use the existing "Add backup track" button to add a new track, then click the text in the new button to confirm that it can also be selected.

example.note: The product category column will be monitored on the parent container. The newly inserted category button and the original button will go through the same process.

hint: When clicking on the edge of the button is valid and clicking on the text is invalid, check whether you read the data-title directly from event.target. Use closest to find the button where the text is located, and then read the button data.
